history.summary: The 807 sqft unit is the project's largest type (1BR+Study penthouse with roof terraces); its eye-catching negative premiums are mostly a size artifact against a shoebox-heavy cohort with only one comparable transaction - a data quirk, not a verified bargain.
history.rating_rationale: The headline signals (-41.5% age-adj, -26.4% vs cohort) rest on psf_cohort_txns of just 1 and appreciation_txns of 10, which v3.4 priors flag as likely quirks. The mechanism is clear: this 807 sqft unit is a 1BR+Study penthouse (per EdgeProp/Stacked the largest of the 58-unit project, with dual roof terraces), and large units structurally trade at far lower psf than the project's 344 sqft shoeboxes that hit $1,682-$3,629 psf. So the -26.4% cohort discount is largely comparing a penthouse to tiny units, not a true mispricing. On absolute terms $1,238 psf freehold in D15 near Katong is fair and the quantum under $1M for a large freehold unit is reasonable, but the value edge the algo flags is inflated and the 58-unit project is illiquid. Neutral at low confidence - not an Avoid (it is a sound freehold asset) but not the bargain the score implies.
